snippet.title: I decided to make my own MMO
snippet.description:
Hey guys, this is the very first intro video to my MMO project. It can be pretty difficult to make videos for me but hopefully it's not too scuffed. If you'd like to follow the project or contact me join my discord, or if you'd like to support the project and receive behind the scenes updates take a look at my patreon. :)


Discord: discord.gg/EzRcp8MfpB
Patreon: patreon.com/c/ProjectReAnim
